'''2011 US Nationals Brian Herold LS Kashyyyk (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Brian Herold]] at [[2011 US Nationals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Kashyyyk (V)|VB5-L-kashyyyk-pre.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' This is Macguyver's Deck
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.3]]
